item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.85.0-beta.1
### Added
- Formatter settings for clause items, AND and OR position, and data type case. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - Vim mode switches tabs with gt, gT, :tabnext and :tabprevious. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - Connect to KingbaseES in PostgreSQL and Oracle compatibility modes with a downloadable driver by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3855](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3855)) - In the export dialog, a database, schema or group row now sets Structure, Drop or Data for every object beneath it. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Copy To can stop and keep what ran, or skip a failing object and continue by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Routine Debugger in Settings > Extensions: step through PL/pgSQL and Oracle PL/SQL routines with breakpoints. ([#3860](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3860)) - Pick a column's character set and collation from the server's own list in Structure and Create Table. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Change a MySQL or MariaDB table's character set, collation and next AUTO_INCREMENT value in Structure > Options. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - File > Discard Changes… discards staged structure or data edits after asking. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - After 30 days of use without a license, a sheet asks once whether you would buy one, then at most every 90 days. ([#3922](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3922)) - Two to six query results show as tabs above the grid, so switching takes one click. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Neo4j connections, with labels and relationship types in the sidebar and Cypher in the editor by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3925](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3925)) - Connect to StarRocks with a downloadable driver, and browse its external catalogs, such as Iceberg, alongside default_catalog by @vbabenkoru. ([#3939](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3939)) - Server Dashboard and Query Insights open with ⌥⇧⌘D and ⌥⇧⌘I, or from a connection's menu on the connections strip by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3957](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3957)) - Table Health lists bloated tables, unused and redundant indexes, and missing keys in a PostgreSQL or MySQL database by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3958](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3958)) - Rows of updatable PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQL Server views that show their table's primary key are editable by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3961](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3961)) - Display As decodes igbinary and Avro values in binary columns, Avro with a schema file chosen for the column by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3962](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3962)) - iPhone and iPad show table rows and query results in a grid with a pinned header and key column, beside the cards by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3963](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3963)) - Qdrant support: browse collections, filter and sort points, edit payloads and vectors, and run REST requests by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3972](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3972)) - InfluxDB 2 and 3 connections, with SQL, InfluxQL and Flux in the editor by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3976](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3976)) - Masking rules hide matching column values in the grid, copies, exports, the AI assistant and MCP by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3978](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3978)) - Display As decodes Protobuf with a .proto file chosen for the column, and Kafka values with a Schema Registry by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3979](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3979)) - Memcached support: browse keys with values and TTLs, edit them in the grid, and run text protocol commands by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3980](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3980)) - Live Messages module: watch PostgreSQL notifications, Redis channels and Kafka topics as messages arrive by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3981](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3981)) - Connection windows show Relaunch to Update in the title bar when an update or plugin update is ready. ([#3993](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3993)) - People without a license see a Black Friday offer on the Welcome window: 40% off Pro until December 1. ([#3995](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3995)) - iPhone and iPad open Cloudflare D1 connections, with the database picked from your account's list. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998))
### Changed
- .sql-formatter.json uses the npm sql-formatter key names, so export a rules file saved by 0.83 again. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - Each export option is now its own column with a heading, and a table's checkbox only includes or excludes it. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Copy To's Stop and roll back now takes back the rows of every table, not only the one that failed by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Settings > Plugins is now Settings > Extensions. ([#3860](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3860)) - The Structure tab shows columns, indexes, foreign keys and checks on one page, with the inspector editing them. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - DuckDB connections run DuckDB 2.0, and a .duckdb file TablePro creates stays readable by DuckDB 1.x. ([#3928](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3928)) - A dragged field in the row inspector keeps its height per column, not for every field of its kind by @vbabenkoru. ([#3975](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3975)) - The paid plan is now called Pro across the app, matching the pricing page. ([#3989](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3989)) - The disk image opens to a window with TablePro beside the Applications folder, ready to drag. ([#3990](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3990)) - Importing an Excel file reads date and time cells as dates and times, as the Data Files window shows them. ([#3991](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3991)) - Settings picks the update channel from a Stable or Beta menu, and the Welcome window always shows the version. ([#3993](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3993)) - An imported Google service account key must be the key itself; a path to a key file is left for you to choose again. - Imported and synced connections ask once before signing in with AWS, Microsoft, Google or Kerberos logins on this Mac. - PostgreSQL reads ~/.pgpass only when Use ~/.pgpass is on. - Through a tunnel, Verify CA and Verify Identity now check the certificate and need its CA file. - Through a tunnel, an SSL mode the driver cannot check there is refused before connecting, naming the modes it can use.
### Fixed
- The sidebar no longer freezes the window for a moment when a very large table list first loads. ([#3849](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3849)) - Format Query changing SQL with brackets, dollar bodies, GO or DELIMITER lines, operators like @> or window ORDER BY. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - The Vim "_ register overwriting the clipboard and the other registers. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - Format Query doing nothing on a statement too large to format, without saying why. ([#3854](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3854)) - The "is not empty" filter found no rows on Oracle, and both empty filters failed on a CLOB column by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3855](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3855)) - A saved export selection made under another format came back with every option turned on. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - The export dialog's Structure, Drop and Data headings sat off their checkboxes and were never translated. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Space over a database and its rows in the export or backup list toggled the rows twice. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Switching an SQL export to CSV and back dropped routines, triggers, sequences and types from the list. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - An MQL export with Data off showed its progress stuck at 0 rows. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - A format change that reloaded the export list dropped each table's row filter. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Opening a query tab, or loading a query, from a query tab left the keyboard in the grid or sidebar. ([#3857](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3857)) - Compare & Sync on MySQL and PostgreSQL wrote tables in name order instead of parents first by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Duplicating a PostgreSQL database failed when a table referenced one in another schema by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - SQL import and Ignore foreign key checks left a SQLite connection enforcing foreign keys afterwards by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Disabling foreign key checks on PostgreSQL without superuser failed the import or aborted the open transaction by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Copy To read a whole database one table at a time before showing the review by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Copy To stopped with a foreign key error on MySQL tables that reference each other or themselves by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - After a Copy To into PostgreSQL failed creating a schema, the next Copy To or Compare on that database could fail by @MrWeb. ([#3859](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3859)) - Changing a column's character set saved without asking first, though characters can be lost. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Editing a column on MariaDB removed its CHECK constraint, the JSON validity check included. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Changing a MySQL text column to a numeric type failed with a syntax error about CHARACTER SET. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - New Database and Duplicate Database on MariaDB 10.10 and later did not offer the uca1400 collations. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - The MariaDB table list showed no character set for tables on a uca1400 collation. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Create Table offered MySQL storage engines the server does not have. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Create Table on MySQL wrote utf8mb4_unicode_ci instead of the database's own default collation. ([#3866](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3866)) - Edit > Undo in the Structure tab did not name the change and stayed enabled with nothing to undo. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - The selection in the Structure tab moved to another column after a reload or a sort. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - Making a column part of the primary key in the Structure tab did not change the table's key. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - MySQL and MariaDB indexes offered a Condition the server drops. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - Switching a table from Structure to Data dimmed Save Changes while structure edits were still staged. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - Undo Delete on an edited column in the Structure tab dropped the edit made before the delete. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - Refreshing the Structure tab, or saving in it, did not read check constraints again. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - One failed read blanked every Structure tab, and a failed Triggers read showed No Triggers. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - Create Table read foreign key targets from the sidebar's database instead of the tab's. ([#3872](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3872)) - What’s New opening on iPhone and iPad after installing an older TestFlight build by @sedax90. ([#3878](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3878)) - The Welcome window offering What’s New after opening an older version, and again after going back to the newer one by @sedax90. ([#3878](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3878)) - Closing or clearing a result dropped its unsaved cell edits without asking. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Closing a result jumped to the last result instead of the one beside it. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - A script's error banner stayed over the results of the statements that succeeded. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - A new run numbered its results from 1 even when pinned results already used those numbers. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Dismissing a failed statement's error turned its result into a success message. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Long result names were cut through an emoji. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Close Result Tab emptied a table tab, and Previous Result and Next Result stayed enabled with nowhere to go. ([#3924](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3924)) - Backing up or restoring a DuckDB database with foreign keys as a .duckdb file failed. ([#3928](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3928)) - Undo in the AI chat composer undid a Structure, Users & Roles or ER diagram edit instead of the typing by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3957](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3957)) - Save at the close prompt closed before inspector edits were written, so a failed write went unreported by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3957](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3957)) - In Agent mode, menu commands and shortcuts acted on the hidden browse tabs, grid and sidebar by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3957](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3957)) - Close Connection with Save closed over unsaved edits in tabs other than the one in front by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3957](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3957)) - Refresh did nothing on the Server Dashboard, Query Insights, Users & Roles and object source tabs by @J2TeamNNL. ([#3958](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3958)) - Dragging a field's resize handle in the row inspector snapped back a few points into the drag by @vbabenkoru. ([#3975](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3975)) - An expanded field in the row inspector collapsed when another row was selected by @vbabenkoru. ([#3975](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3975)) - The SQLite restore confirmation said existing objects get the dump's data, though the restore stops at the first error. ([#3984](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3984)) - A crafted Excel, CSV or compressed file could hang TablePro or fill memory and disk. ([#3991](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3991)) - Malformed replies from Kafka, Teradata, Redis, Neo4j, Trino and other servers could crash TablePro. ([#3991](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3991)) - Relaunching from Settings could leave two copies of TablePro running when the quit was cancelled. ([#3993](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3993)) - An update downloaded in the background gave no sign until TablePro quit. ([#3993](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3993)) - A Snowflake connect that fails on the network no longer forgets the cached SSO or MFA token. ([#3996](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3996)) - Cloudflare D1 queries with no LIMIT downloading every row, which fails once the result passes 50 MB. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - A connection switched to SQLite or DuckDB on iPhone and iPad still dialing the SSH tunnel it had before. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - A query on a table or column named fetch skipping the row limit. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - Cloudflare D1 connection failures reading "Failed to connect" instead of the cause, such as an expired token. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - A Cloudflare D1 database past the first 1,000 in an account not found by name or missing from the switcher. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - Cloudflare D1 values sent as arrays, such as BLOBs, showing as NULL. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - Saving a binary value to Cloudflare D1 storing its base64 text instead of the bytes. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - Truncate Table on a SQLite connection on iPhone and iPad failing with a syntax error. ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - Filtering a Cloudflare D1 table by a long text value failing with "LIKE or GLOB pattern too complex". ([#3998](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3998)) - A keyless save matched no row when a PostGIS coordinate had more than 15 decimal places. - An enum or other new type column could read as plain text for the rest of the session after a cancelled query. - Geometry and geography values showed as hex after CREATE EXTENSION postgis until you reconnected. - New Kafka connections showing Verify Identity while connecting without TLS.
### Security
- A Beancount BQL query starting with a dash could read any local file, including from MCP and AI tools. - A Cassandra function body holding $$ or a crafted type name could add a statement to its definition. - A DuckDB macro name, or a MySQL routine made under another sql_mode, could add statements to Copy To and sync. - A DuckDB name quoted in backticks hiding a statement from Safe Mode and read-only external clients. - A Kafka DROP TOPIC behind a comma or a Greek question mark skipping the confirmation MCP clients need. - A MongoDB statement from an MCP client could drop data or run server-side JavaScript without the confirmation it needs. - A MySQL value ending in a backslash could end its literal early in a saved sync script, MCP export or copied INSERT. - A NUL character in an imported connection value could quit the app when it started a backup, tunnel or other tool. - A PostgreSQL E'' string continued on the next line hiding a statement from Safe Mode and read-only external clients. - A SELECT INTO written right after a number passing as a read in Safe Mode and for external clients. - A SQL Server batch opening with SHOW, HELP, INFO, EXPLAIN or DESCRIBE, which runs a procedure, passing as a read. - A SQL Server column name holding ] could end its quoting in the table DDL and run the rest as SQL. - A SQL file or a functional index read under NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES could run text from inside a string. - A Snowflake account written as an address sending a cached sign-in token to another server. - A Snowflake or Vault server opening a file or another app's link during browser sign-in. - A Trino or Presto query parameter after a ? in a comment or a quoted name could run as SQL. - A Weaviate DELETE with a tab or other space after the verb skipping the destructive prompt. - A column default or type a SQL Server, MySQL 5.7, SAP HANA or Trino server reported could run as SQL in copied DDL. - A comment in a SQLite, libSQL or D1 table definition could add statements to a SQL export. - A connection file imported with Replace sending a saved password to a server the file named. - A connection file or synced password naming a Google key file on this Mac signing in with that key. - A connection from a file, link or team library signing in with this Mac's AWS, Microsoft, Google or Kerberos login. - A question mark in a quoted name could bind a value as SQL on Teradata, and in backtick or bracket names. - A read from an MCP client, AppleScript or the assistant writing data on PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB or ClickHouse. - A shared connection sending values of TablePro's environment variables to its server without asking. - A tampered plugin registry replacing an installed plugin with an older release. - AWS, Microsoft, AI provider and license requests following a redirect to another server with their keys. - An ALTER that drops a column after a line break, tab, comma or parenthesis running without the destructive prompt. - An SSH host or user with a Greek question mark or varia could run commands through a Match exec line in ~/.ssh/config. - An imported or shared connection carrying settings TablePro sets itself, or fields this version does not know. - Another account on the Mac could answer the MCP bridge after TablePro quit. - CockroachDB connections could run a version() or count() function another user planted in a schema on the path. - Deleting or editing a MongoDB row whose _id held a toEJSON field could change a different document. - MCP browse_table and count_rows reading rows without the confirmation Safe Mode asks for. - MCP confirmations not naming the database a statement runs in, or the values insert_rows writes. - MongoDB on iPhone and iPad not checking the server's name through SSH with Verify Identity. - Oracle EXPLAIN PLAN INTO a table, which inserts the plan, passing as a read for read-only external clients. - PostgreSQL crosstab, connectby, xpath_table and pg_import_system_collations, and DuckDB query(), passing as reads. - Safe Mode on iPhone and iPad passing server file reads, such as pg_read_file and LOAD_FILE, as reads. - Setting a PostgreSQL sequence past its column could run an operator the database owner planted ahead of pg_catalog. - Shortcuts listing tables and adding rows on iPhone and iPad while TablePro was locked. - Shortening DynamoDB point-in-time recovery, or an UpdateTable setting the app does not know, passing as a plain write. - SurrealDB REMOVE TABLE, Snowflake REMOVE, and MySQL or Oracle PURGE or RESET MASTER skipping the destructive prompt. - Table Health, a primary key change in Structure or a backup could run a function planted in a PostgreSQL schema as you. - Table names, Copilot tool results and iPhone server errors reaching the system log in clear. - The assistant's confirm_destructive_operation running statements that read server files or run server code. - Verify CA and Verify Identity checking no certificate when connecting through an SSH, Cloudflare or other tunnel. - With Python Beancount, a ledger could run code with Run Ledger Plugins off, through a bundled plugin or a nearby file.
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.85.0-beta.1)

# What's New in TablePro 0.84.0
Find and Replace work in every data grid, with Match Case, Whole Words, regular expressions and a column scope.
Click a sorted header to reverse it or Option-click to add a sort key. Frozen columns sort, resize and reorder from their own headers.
A cell value with a line break or over 256 characters opens in an editor anchored to the cell.
The sidebar, Open Quickly, autocomplete and AI chat no longer stall on databases with tens of thousands of tables.
Procedures and Functions load on MySQL 5.x and MariaDB servers with many routines, and MariaDB packages open.
Save Changes has its own toolbar section, and panes switch views with native tabs.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.84.0-beta.2
### Changed
- MCP list_indexes reads a whole schema's indexes in one query where the database supports it. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - The AI chat Tables menu lists the first 100 tables; type @ in the message to find any other. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Right-clicking a cell outside the selection acts on that cell and leaves the selection where it was. ([#3833](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3833)) - Frozen columns sort, resize and reorder from their own headers at any scroll position. ([#3833](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3833)) - Find works in every data grid, with Match Case, Whole Words, Regular Expression, a column scope and Replace. ([#3833](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3833)) - Clicking a sorted column header reverses the sort; Option-click adds a sort key and Don't Sort is in the header menu. ([#3833](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3833)) - A cell value with a line break or over 256 characters opens in an editor anchored to the cell. ([#3833](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3833)) - A theme that leaves out the data grid header or selected text colors uses the macOS colors instead of its grid colors. ([#3837](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3837)) - Filtering the sidebar on a database with many schemas or tables responds faster. ([#3842](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3842)) - Connecting with a downloaded driver such as Oracle no longer freezes the window while the driver loads. ([#3842](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3842)) - Opening a connection on saved tabs and filtering a large sidebar pause the window less. ([#3846](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3846)) - Save Changes sits in its own toolbar section, and panes switch views with native tabs across the app. ([#3851](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3851)) - Typing in the sidebar filter no longer redraws the editor and results on every keystroke. ([#3876](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3876)) - Open Quickly opens faster after the first time in a window. ([#3888](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3888)) - Open Quickly no longer redraws the whole sidebar when it finishes listing the tables of every schema. ([#3888](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3888)) - The sidebar search responds faster on a database with many schemas. ([#3889](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3889)) - Open Quickly opens faster the first time after launch. ([#3889](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3889))
### Fixed
- Test Connection and Retry on iPhone and iPad hanging when their screen closed before the SSH server asked. ([#3813](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3813)) - The sidebar, Open Quickly and autocomplete stalled on databases with tens of thousands of tables. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Searching the sidebar on Oracle waited seconds for other schemas' tables, longer over a slow network. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Oracle and other one-row-per-schema sidebars could not select a schema row, so the keyboard could not open one. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Autocomplete could leave the best matching table name out on databases with more than 400 tables. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Autocomplete offered nothing after a database name and a dot on MySQL, MariaDB and other engines without schemas. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Autocomplete offered nothing after a schema name and a dot typed in another case. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Sending an AI chat message froze the app on a database with thousands of tables. ([#3830](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3830)) - Opening a connection or a query tab paused while every editor built a find bar nobody had opened yet. ([#3831](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3831)) - Open Quickly said No results for a table in another schema while the sidebar was still loading the tables. ([#3831](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3831)) - A sidebar search read a table list that had failed to load again on every keystroke. ([#3831](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3831)) - On Oracle with many schemas, the first sidebar search and Open Quickly waited up to two seconds for the table list. # What's New in TablePro 0.83.1
### Changed
- With CanonicalizeHostname, a DNS alias is followed only where CanonicalizePermittedCNAMEs allows it.
### Removed
- DuckDB Restore no longer accepts a folder of Parquet files, only a .duckdb file.
### Fixed
- A table tab could reload under an open cell and drop what you were typing after a save in another window. ([#3848](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3848)) - Edits made to rows while a query or refresh was still loading new ones were discarded when it finished. ([#3848](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3848)) - Table tabs ran their query again when you switched back to them or returned to TablePro from another app. ([#3848](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3848)) - A table tab waiting for its connection could run the statement under the cursor in a query tab instead. ([#3848](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3848)) - On iOS, a search or filter with a backslash on MySQL or ClickHouse, or with `[` on SQL Server, matched the wrong rows. ([#3906](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3906)) - A DELETE with no WHERE running unconfirmed behind EXPLAIN ANALYZE, an unusual CTE, or a WHERE glued to a name. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE, SCHEMA or DATABASE replacing data without the confirmation DROP gets. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - HTTP drivers such as Typesense following a server's redirect to another address with the connection's key. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - Spanner, BigQuery and Teradata saving a grid change they could not key to the default schema's table. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - Teradata showing each result one statement late after a statement hit the 20-second receive timeout. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - DuckDB's Open the File Read-Only being ignored for a database not named .duckdb or .ddb. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - T-SQL BULK INSERT and OPENROWSET, and MongoDB $_internalJs operators, passing the external file and code refusals. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - Bigtable saving a grid change to another row when the key starts with a combining mark. ([#3907](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3907)) - DuckDB Back Up to a .duckdb file, and DuckDB Restore, failed with "Cannot prepare multiple statements at once". - Pull in a linked folder failing when the repository is a partial clone.
### Security
- A backslash in a Snowflake filter value could end its string literal and run the rest as SQL. ([#3906](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3906)) - A Firebase Database URL with an encoded slash sending your Google access token to another host. - A PostgreSQL or SQL Server database name could send Back Up or Restore, with its password, to another server. - A PostgreSQL type named geometry or geography that PostGIS did not create could run its owner's code as you. - A SQL export carrying a statement of its own in a cell value, a type name or a table comment when restored. - A Typesense path with dot segments, or a Firebase or Bigtable request behind a comment, passing the read-only check. - A credential profile in a shared connection file reading ~/.pgpass and sending the password to a host the file named. - A name with a quote before an accent mark could run its own SQL when you browsed, searched or exported the table. - A remote SQLite file path with a quote and a combining accent could run commands on the SSH server. - A write after a CTE list, a Snowflake ->> chain, or inside a SurrealDB or CockroachDB SELECT passing as a read. - ANALYZE TABLE, EXPLAIN PRAGMA and SQLite pragma_optimize passing as reads for read-only external clients. - An imported SSH host or user could run commands through a Match exec line in ~/.ssh/config. - An imported SSH host with a line break could make TablePro trust a host key for another server. - Browsing a PostgreSQL schema could run a function or operator its owner planted there, with your privileges. - CanonicalizeFallbackLocal no was ignored, and an SSH tunnel dialed the short host name anyway. - CanonicalizeHostname followed any DNS alias, so DNS chose the host key an SSH tunnel was checked against. - Cassandra and ScyllaDB connections through a tunnel signing in to other cluster nodes outside the tunnel. - Dameng connections set to Required or a Verify mode connecting without TLS. - EXPLAIN or DESCRIBE with a parenthesised query or a quoted option passing as a read for read-only MCP clients. - File and URL reads through DuckDB, ClickHouse, quoted function names or VACUUM INTO passing the external check. - Git status for a linked folder running filter and fetch commands set up in that folder's own Git configuration. - Import Commands showing the first 300 characters of Startup SQL while keeping all of it. - MCP clients and the assistant running statements past Read Only on Dameng behind a comment the driver read differently. - MCP clients running DROP or server API calls unasked through grid requests on BigQuery, Elasticsearch and Typesense. - MCP clients running DROP unasked on Trino and Presto behind a statement the driver split differently from the gate. - MCP clients running statements or changing consistency past Read Only on Cassandra and ScyllaDB with a forged comment. - MCP clients with read access running writes through browse_table or get_table_statistics with a crafted table name. - MCP clients, the AI assistant and AppleScript running a second statement the Read Only and destructive checks missed. - Open Project Folder filling a project's ${VAR} references from TablePro's own environment. - Opening a crafted table on iPhone or iPad running a second statement on PostgreSQL, Redshift or SQL Server. - Oracle Explain reading a PLAN_TABLE or V$ views planted in the tab's schema instead of Oracle's own. - Restoring a DuckDB folder of Parquet files ran its schema.sql with file access, so the folder could write any file. - Restoring a MySQL or MariaDB dump could run shell commands written in the .sql file. - Restoring a SQLite dump could run shell commands written in the .sql file. - SQL Server EXEC of a string, sp_executesql, OPENQUERY and OPENROWSET passing as reads or without the code check. - SQL Server Verify CA and Verify Identity on iPhone and iPad connecting without checking the certificate. - Secrets in a pasted MongoDB connection string saved outside the Keychain and carried by exports, links and sync. - Shared connections reusing your Entra ID token, Snowflake CLI profile, MongoDB AWS credentials or Run Ledger Plugins. - Teradata with SSL through a tunnel sending the password to port 443 on this Mac. - Trino and Presto sending the password or token to another host the server named in its reply. - iPhone and iPad Safe Mode letting DESC ANALYZE of a write, OPENQUERY and state-changing calls run as reads.

# What's New in TablePro 0.83.0
Search Database finds a value in every table, Compare Results matches two results row by row, and Generate Rows fills a table with test data.
Users & Roles for SQL Server and Oracle, Server Dashboard for Oracle, MongoDB and Redis, and Explain plans for Oracle and SQL Server.
Sign in with Kerberos on PostgreSQL and MariaDB, through a HashiCorp Vault role, or with AWS IAM on Redshift.
MySQL and MariaDB no longer send a password in plain text to a server without TLS.
SSH tunnels drop SHA-1 key exchange, ssh-rsa, 3DES, Blowfish and RC4. A server that needs one gets an error naming it.
Vim mode moved to Settings > Editor > Key bindings, which adds Emacs. iPhone and iPad open MongoDB and ClickHouse.
